tools.name: pobuca_get_me
tools.description: The Pobuca Connect user this API key acts as: id, first name, last name and email. GET /api/v1/Users/Me.

tools.name: pobuca_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people) with names, phones, emails, addresses, organization, team, tags and custom fields. Paged: 50 per call at most; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Supports OData $filter and $orderby. To find recently changed contacts use $filter like "updatedat ge 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z".

tools.name: pobuca_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id, with all phone numbers, emails, addresses, organization, team, tags and custom fields. GET /api/v1/Contacts/{id}.

tools.name: pobuca_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new contact in the Pobuca Connect address book. Needs at least a first name, last name or email. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two contacts, so search with pobuca_list_contacts first. POST /api/v1/Contacts.

tools.name: pobuca_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact; only the fields you pass are sent. Overwrites the previous values (tags and customFields are replaced as given). Look the contact up first and confirm the right one. PATCH /api/v1/Contacts/{id}.

tools.name: pobuca_list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations (companies) with phone, email, website, billing and shipping addresses, type, industry, tags and custom fields. Paged: 50 per call at most; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Supports OData $filter and $orderby. GET /api/v1/Organizations.

tools.name: pobuca_get_organization
tools.description: One organization by id, with addresses, type, industry, primary contact, tags and custom fields. GET /api/v1/Organizations/{id}.

tools.name: pobuca_create_organization
tools.description: WRITE: create a new organization (company) in Pobuca Connect. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two organizations, so search with pobuca_list_organizations first. POST /api/v1/Organizations.

tools.name: pobuca_update_organization
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing organization; only the fields you pass are sent. Overwrites the previous values (tags and customFields are replaced as given). Look the organization up first and confirm the right one. PATCH /api/v1/Organizations/{id}.

tools.name: pobuca_list_teams
tools.description: List teams (the groups that own and share contacts). Paged: 50 per call at most; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Supports OData $filter and $orderby. GET /api/v1/Teams.

tools.name: pobuca_list_team_members
tools.description: List which users belong to which team, with their role in the team. Paged: 50 per call at most; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Supports OData $filter and $orderby. GET /api/v1/UserTeams.

tools.name: pobuca_list_departments
tools.description: List departments (ids for the departmentId of a contact). Paged: 50 per call at most; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Supports OData $filter and $orderby. GET /api/v1/Departments.

tools.name: pobuca_list_industries
tools.description: List industries (ids for the industryId of an organization). Paged: 50 per call at most; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Supports OData $filter and $orderby. GET /api/v1/Industries.

tools.name: pobuca_list_organization_types
tools.description: List organization types (ids for the organizationTypeId of an organization). Paged: 50 per call at most; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Supports OData $filter and $orderby. GET /api/v1/OrganizationTypes.

tools.name: pobuca_list_countries
tools.description: List countries with their codes. Paged: 50 per call at most; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Supports OData $filter and $orderby. GET /api/v1/Countries.

tools.name: pobuca_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields defined for contacts, organizations ('Group') or users, with type (Text or Dropdown) and, for dropdowns, the available options. Use the ids and option ids in the customFields of a contact or organization. GET /api/v1/CustomFields/{entityType}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pobuca_get_me, pobuca_list_contacts, pobuca_get_contact, pobuca_create_contact, pobuca_list_organizations, pobuca_create_organization · Private data: pobuca_get_me, pobuca_list_contacts, pobuca_get_contact, pobuca_create_contact, pobuca_update_contact, pobuca_get_organization, pobuca_list_teams, pobuca_list_departments, pobuca_list_custom_fields · Public sink: pobuca_get_me, pobuca_create_contact, pobuca_list_organizations, pobuca_create_organization, pobuca_list_teams.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pobuca_get_me, pobuca_list_contacts, pobuca_get_contact, pobuca_create_contact, pobuca_list_organizations, pobuca_create_organization · Private data: pobuca_get_me, pobuca_list_contacts, pobuca_get_contact, pobuca_create_contact, pobuca_update_contact, pobuca_get_organization, pobuca_list_teams, pobuca_list_departments, pobuca_list_custom_fields · Public sink: pobuca_get_me, pobuca_create_contact, pobuca_list_organizations, pobuca_create_organization, pobuca_list_teams

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
